author: sysdesigndaily
text: Hot take after our outage: always prewarm your cache before a traffic spike. Cold caches at peak = self-inflicted DDoS. Prewarm on deploy, not on first request.

author: fitwithmaya
text: Reel: 12-min zone 2 morning routine. Try it tomorrow at 7am — no equipment, just consistency. Your future self will thank you.

author: sfaihub
text: We're hosting an AI infra meetup next Friday 6pm at our Menlo Park office. RSVP link in bio. Lightning talks + demos.

author: careercoachraj
text: Before every interview: write 3 stories using STAR format. Situation, Task, Action, Result. Practice them out loud once. This beats memorizing 50 leetcode patterns for behavioral rounds.

author: frugalfounder
text: Set up an automatic transfer of 10% of every paycheck to a high-yield savings account the day it lands. You can't spend what you never see.

author: devtoolsdaily
text: Reel: stop writing git log --oneline every time. `git config --global alias.lg "log --oneline --graph --decorate"` — 5 seconds now, hours saved forever.

author: mindfulmaker
text: Sunday reset checklist: clear desk, plan top 3 for the week, 30 min walk no phone. Do it this Sunday evening.

author: papersweekly
text: Underrated: read one research paper abstract every morning with coffee. 5 minutes a day compounds into actually knowing your field.
